capabilities: Compare the active file with another file and view differences
Merge changes between the two compared files
Find all Syncthing conflict files and resolve each with the merge option
extras: Only one Syncthing-related command depends on Syncthing; comparison and merging work without it. Instructions for adjusting colors are linked rather than included in the README.
motivation: The author uses Syncthing and was annoyed by manually cleaning up merge conflicts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view differences between two files and merge them, and sync tools like Syncthing leave conflict files that must be cleaned up by hand.

relations.evidence: Finds all Syncthing conflicts and shows the merge option for each conflict sequentially.

summary: Diff tool that compares two vault files, merges differences, and sequentially resolves Syncthing sync conflicts.
